Image Converter

Change the format of your pictures in seconds. Convert PNG to JPG, JPG to WebP, WebP to PNG and more, one file or a hundred at a time. Transparent areas turn into a colour of your choice when saving as JPG.

How to use Image Converter

  1. Add your images.
  2. Choose the format to convert to: JPG, PNG or WebP.
  3. Adjust quality for JPG and WebP.
  4. Click Convert and download the files or a ZIP.

Frequently asked questions

Which format should I choose?

Use JPG for photos, PNG when you need transparency or sharp graphics, and WebP for the smallest files on websites.

What happens to transparent backgrounds?

JPG can't be transparent, so transparent areas are filled with the background colour you pick (white by default). PNG and WebP keep transparency.

Does it convert animated GIFs?

Only the first frame is converted.
